text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: In life—there are many special days.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Birthdays, Shichi-Go-San, wedding anniversaries...
They're all wonderfully joyous occasions. But..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today is many, many times more wonderful
than any anniversary could ever be!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The day we run a GⅠ together with Dia-chan!
We've been aiming for this day all along!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, entering to thunderous cheers!
Ranked number one in the fan vote, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Has there ever been an Umamusume so ever-increasingly beloved? Massive cheering banners are waving across the paddock!"
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next, making a dazzling entrance!
Ranked 2nd in fan voting, Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The daughter of immense wealth, bathed in the spotlight since before her debut. The finest diamond now shines right here!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Childhood best friends locked in battle!
Could anyone have scripted such unbelievable drama?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way... Well, maybe it's not so unexpected.
After all, we made it this far because the two of us were together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: “You're right. But I'm truly grateful that so many people voted for me.”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the vote count... was slightly in my favor.
Though it was really close.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be chasing after Kita-chan
from slightly behind. Just like always, huh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You were chasing after me with such intensity that you startled me. But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pass! In the race, I'm going to cross that finish line with Dia-chan right behind me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "I won't let it end like that. This time, I'm going to turn the tables. I'll make sure to cross the finish line one step ahead of Kita-chan."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's hype it up! The two of us, making this the best festival ever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Our dream... has finally come true!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And this Arima Kinen is not a showdown
between just the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A super Umamusume who has created countless miracles makes a surprise entry!
Will she bring about yet another miracle today?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san... I look forward to
working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I have to admit, I was surprised when I learned
you'd be entering this race."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, today I consider myself the challenger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A challenger?! But Teio-san has always
been my role model..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Kita-chan's
a Triple Crown Umamusume, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to surpass it purely.
Not with numbers or stats, but with these legs of mine."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Will you let me join in on your dream?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! Please let me repay the dream right here, today!

A lineup that could truly be called the culmination
of Kitasan Black's journey had assembled.
The person she looks up to and her eternal best friend. An unforgettable dream race is about to begin!
